Elections

Voting

Voting is your expression, it is your voice, it is your constitutional right. You, as a Rowlett citizen, have an opportunity to express your voice through your vote! If you would like additional information about voting in the City of Rowlett, contact the City Secretary’s Office at 972-412-6109.

Voting in November 3, 2026 Elections

Election Day is November 3, 2026, polling locations will be open 7 am to 7 pm for Dallas and Rockwall Counties.

City Elections - Council Candidates

The City of Rowlett operates under a Council - Manager form of government. The Mayor and six councilmembers are elected at-large. In May 2003, Rowlett residents approved an amendment to the City Charter (PDF) that allowed for three-year staggered terms for the City Council.

City Council Term Expirations

  • Mayor and Places Two, Four and Six: May 2028
  • Places One, Three and Five: May 2029 

Councilmember Qualifications

According to the City of Rowlett City Charter, Article III, Section 3.03, a City Council candidate must:

  • Be a qualified voter of the City of Rowlett.
  • Be a resident of the City of Rowlett for not less than one year preceeding the day of the election.
  • Should not be in arrears in the payment of any taxes to the City of Rowlett, unless such arrearage is subject to a lawful protest.
